{{Short description|Czech number-based board game and browser game}}'''Abaku''' is a Czech number-based board game and [[browser game]] used in mathematics education. In the game, players place digit tiles on a board to form valid [[arithmetic operations]] without writing mathematical symbols. Czech media have described Abaku as a numerical game comparable in principle to word-based tile-placement games such as [[Scrabble]], and have reported on both its physical and online forms.<ref name="ct24">{{cite news |title=Abaku není zaklínadlo, ale cesta k bravurnímu počtářství |url=https://ct24.ceskatelevize.cz/clanek/domaci/abaku-neni-zaklinadlo-ale-cesta-k-bravurnimu-poctarstvi-309082 |work=ČT24 |publisher=Czech Television |date=12 September 2013 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref><ref name="lidovky">{{cite news |title=Češi vymysleli hru, která slouží i při výuce matematiky |url=https://www.lidovky.cz/relax/design/cesi-vymysleli-spolecenskou-hru-ktera-slouzi-i-pri-vyuce-matematiky.A150202_181706_ln-bydleni_ape |work=Lidovky.cz |date=13 February 2015 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

== Independent media coverage ==

Czech Television covered Abaku in a 2013 [[ČT24]] article, describing it as an original Czech numerical game with both computer and board-game versions and discussing its use in schools.<ref name="ct24" /> In 2015, [[Lidovky.cz]] published an article about Abaku as a Czech social game used in mathematics teaching, including an interview with Vladimír Tesař about the game and its principles.<ref name="lidovky" />

Czech Television also covered Abaku in children's programming. In 2016, ''Planeta Yó'' broadcast a board-game review of Abaku.<ref name="ct-review">{{cite web |title=Recenze deskovky: Abaku |url=https://www.ceskatelevize.cz/porady/10315711050-planeta-yo/216543118520001/cast/506205/ |website=Česká televize |date=23 November 2016 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref> The same programme separately broadcast a report about the Abaku school league.<ref name="ct-league">{{cite web |title=Planeťácká reportáž: Školní liga Abaku |url=https://decko.ceskatelevize.cz/video/i501776 |website=Déčko |publisher=Czech Television |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref> The Czech Television programme ''Wifina'' also featured Abaku in a segment on leisure activities.<ref name="wifina">{{cite web |title=Wifina — Volný čas: Abaku |url=https://decko.ceskatelevize.cz/video/i535903 |website=Déčko |publisher=Czech Television |date=7 April 2017 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

Czech Radio Ostrava broadcast a 2024 report about an Abaku tournament in [[Ostrava]], describing Abaku as an original Czech game and method supporting arithmetic.<ref name="rozhlas">{{cite web |last=Štrymplová |first=Petra |title=Děti v se v Ostravě utkaly na turnaji v abaku. Jejich soupeřem byl Jaromír Nohavica |url=https://ostrava.rozhlas.cz/deti-v-se-v-ostrave-utkaly-na-turnaji-v-abaku-jejich-souperem-byl-jaromir-9324554 |website=Český rozhlas Ostrava |date=30 September 2024 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Abaku is played with number tiles. Players arrange digits horizontally or vertically so that the resulting sequences represent valid arithmetic operations. The principle has been compared to Scrabble, but with numbers instead of letters.<ref name="mfi">{{cite journal |last=Kačenková |first=Olga |title=Hra Abaku |journal=Matematika–Fyzika–Informatika |volume=26 |issue=2 |pages=90–94 |date=2017 |url=https://www.mfi.upol.cz/index.php/mfi/article/view/323 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref><ref name="bgg">{{cite web |title=Abaku |url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/173390/abaku |website=BoardGameGeek |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

The online version has been presented as Abaku PLAY, while school-oriented use has also been associated with Abaku LAB.<ref name="academics">{{cite web |title=Abaku PLAY |url=https://www.academicschoice.com/games/abaku-play.php |website=Academics' Choice |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

== Educational use ==

Abaku has been used in Czech mathematics education as a [[Didactic method|didactic]] environment for practising arithmetic relationships. H-mat, the organisation associated with the Hejný method of mathematics teaching, describes Abaku as an environment whose main aim is to strengthen basic arithmetic connections, including addition and multiplication facts.<ref name="hmat-blog">{{cite web |title=Abaku |url=https://blog.h-mat.cz/didakticka-prostredi/abaku |website=Blog o Hejného metodě |publisher=H-mat |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

A 2021 article in the journal ''Učitel matematiky'' analysed the Abaku learning environment as a tool for investigating the idea of an additive triad. The article presents classroom activities using Abaku to support pupils' understanding of equality, left-to-right reading of equations and commutativity.<ref name="mottlova">{{cite journal |last=Mottlová |first=Karolína |title=Prostředí Abaku jako nástroj pro zkoumání myšlenky aditivní triády |journal=Učitel matematiky |volume=29 |issue=2 |pages=67–78 |date=2021 |url=https://eudml.org/doc/297496 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

== School competition ==

Abaku is also used in a Czech school competition known as Liga Abaku. The Society of Czech Mathematicians and Physicists describes Liga Abaku as a nationwide school online competition in the number game Abaku.<ref name="suma">{{cite web |title=Soutěže |url=https://suma.jcmf.cz/souteze/ |website=SUMA JČMF |publisher=Jednota českých matematiků a fyziků |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

The Faculty of Education of [[Charles University]] hosted the final of the national school league in 2017 in cooperation with [[Mensa International|Mensa]] Czech Republic and Abaku. According to the faculty's event listing, 50 pupils qualified for the final.<ref name="pedf">{{cite web |title=Finále školní ligy v Abaku |url=https://pedf.cuni.cz/PEDF-61.html?event=15238&lang=cz |website=Pedagogická fakulta, Univerzita Karlova |date=12 June 2017 |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref> Mensa Czech Republic also lists the Abaku school league among its projects for pupils and teachers.<ref name="mensa">{{cite web |title=ABAKU školní liga |url=https://deti.mensa.cz/projekt/126-abaku-skolni-liga/ |website=Děti Mensa |publisher=Mensa Česko |language=cs |access-date=20 August 2026}}</ref>

== Recognition ==

Abaku PLAY was listed as an Academics' Choice Award winner in the category "Game, Website".<ref name="academics" />
